item.title: A shitbox as a step towards digital sovereignty (Nextcloud setup)
item.description:
Trying to selfhost basic services: attempt 953284753.

Once again did the reality dawn on me. To check my upcoming appointments, I open… Google Calendar. To open one of my prehistoric files I had on a computer I put away in 2017, I open… Google Drive. To listen to music on my phone, I use… YouTube Music (ReVanced, true, but my point still stands). Preposterous!

However, all past attempts at trying to create a home server went close to this:

item.title: Contact
item.description:
In order not to become even more socially isolated from my peers, I feel forced to maintain “normie” channels of communication alongside channels I would actually prefer to use (i.e. privacy-respecting channels). The links themselves are ordered in my order of preference – if you’re in a position to choose a channel, I will be forever thankful if you opt for one as high up as possible.

Instant Messaging
